name: YeboMart

features.title: Mobile point of sale | YeboMart
features.description: Use YeboMart’s mobile till to sell items and keep sales, stock and receipts together.
features.headline: Ring up the sale. Let the stock count follow.
features.intro:
Scan a product or tap it on the till. Check the basket, take the payment and give the customer a receipt.

The sale sits alongside your shop’s stock and daily figures, so you do not have to copy the same transaction into another stock book.
paragraphs: Scan a product or tap it on the till. Check the basket, take the payment and give the customer a receipt.
The sale sits alongside your shop’s stock and daily figures, so you do not have to copy the same transaction into another stock book.

benefits.title: Sell from the till
benefits.body: Find the items, check quantities and see the total before finishing the sale.

benefits.title: Know who served the customer
benefits.body: Use the cashier’s access so the sale and any later changes have a staff name attached.

benefits.title: Keep the receipt handy
benefits.body: Find the sale again when a customer asks a question or the owner needs to check it.

steps: Finish the sale and give the receipt.
features.limitations: Payment methods and receipt options depend on the shop’s setup.
features.example: A cashier sells several items, checks the total once and completes the sale. The shop can follow that same sale in its stock and takings.
features.availability: Available features depend on your account and setup.

features.title: Stock management | YeboMart
features.description: Follow stock quantities, sales and new deliveries in YeboMart.
features.headline: See what is left before the shelf is empty.
features.intro:
Know what is in the shop, what sold and what just arrived. YeboMart keeps stock work beside the till, so the count is connected to the day’s sales.

When a delivery arrives, enter what you actually received. Check low-stock and reorder information before deciding what to buy next.
paragraphs: Know what is in the shop, what sold and what just arrived. YeboMart keeps stock work beside the till, so the count is connected to the day’s sales.
When a delivery arrives, enter what you actually received. Check low-stock and reorder information before deciding what to buy next.

benefits.title: Follow the count
benefits.body: See the stock on hand and the changes behind it, rather than relying only on the last physical count.

benefits.title: Receive a delivery
benefits.body: Check the products and quantities as they arrive. Enter the amount supplied, even if it differs from the order.

benefits.title: Plan the next order
benefits.body: Use the shop’s stock and sales information to see what needs attention before making another purchase.

features.limitations: Stock figures depend on accurate receiving and adjustments. Check the shelf when a quantity looks wrong.
features.example: If fewer cartons arrive than expected, enter the amount received. The shop’s next stock decision should use that figure, not the original order quantity.
features.availability: Available features depend on your account and setup.

features.title: Cash-up and cashier reports | YeboMart
features.description: Compare opening float, cash sales and the closing count in YeboMart.
features.headline: Count the drawer. See the difference.
features.intro:
Start the till with the money in the drawer. At closing, count the cash and compare it with what YeboMart expects.

If the numbers differ, look through the day’s sales and changes. Staff names and the audit log help you find the entries worth checking.
paragraphs: Start the till with the money in the drawer. At closing, count the cash and compare it with what YeboMart expects.
If the numbers differ, look through the day’s sales and changes. Staff names and the audit log help you find the entries worth checking.

benefits.title: Start with the float
benefits.body: Enter the actual opening cash so the closing comparison has the right starting point.

benefits.title: Keep staff names on the work
benefits.body: Cashiers use their own access for sales, voids and refunds.

benefits.title: Check the difference
benefits.body: See the variance when you close. Look at the relevant transactions before deciding what caused it.

steps: Open the till with its float.
Check the difference and its entries.
features.limitations: A difference in the drawer needs investigation. It does not prove theft or who caused it.
features.example: At closing, the manager counts the drawer and sees a difference. They can check sales and refunds before deciding what needs correcting.
features.availability: Available features depend on your account and setup.

availability: Available features depend on your account and setup.
